# Coffreo

Coffreo is a Information Technology & Services company. Coffreo employs 36 people (-36.8% YoY, -21 people), founded in 2007. Headquartered in Orsay, Île-de-France, France, with offices in Aubière and Paris. Its workforce is distributed across France and Spain.

## About

We provide two main services for our customers.

First service is a BtoB one: we help HR department to dematerialize relationship with their employees. We catch and deliver all kind of documents issued of HR solution like pay slip and contract and bonus… Employer realizes savings, reduces its footprint, offer a new and smart service to its employees
 http://www.coffreo.info

Second one is a BtoC one: we are focused on employees and the quality of the services we provide to them with our electronic safe box, Coffreo. We store for them in the best way their dematerialized pay slips, contracts and other documents submitted by HR department, and data are available without cost for lifetime. Coffreo is also a personal space to store personal and confidential electronic data, and it is independent of the contractual relationship with employer.
http://www.coffreo.com

# ENSO

ENSO is a Software Development company. Enso is a company that provides new generation internal management solutions, including recruitment, payroll, DSN multi-agence, and customization. They offer services for various sectors including private security, live entertainment, catering, hospitality, cleaning, medical, and public sector. ENSO employs 113 people (+21.5% YoY, +20 people), founded in 1994. Headquartered in Wettolsheim, Grand Est, France. Its workforce is distributed across France and Switzerland.

## About

ENSO, le partenaire technologique de référence des agences d’intérim.
Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous concevons des solutions logicielles robustes, évolutives et adaptées aux enjeux du travail temporaire. Notre Suite ENSO – innovante, modulaire et performante – accompagne la digitalisation et l’optimisation des agences.
